title: Giant Praya Siphonophore
subtitle: Colonial Zooid Helical Chain & Bioluminescent Net
description: Deep ocean Praya dubia siphonophore colony modeled as a 3D helical coenosarc stem of swimming nectophores with trailing bioluminescent red/blue tentilla fishing lattices.
mathNotation: \mathbf{r}_{\text{stem}}(s, t) = \begin{bmatrix} s L \\ R_s \sin(4\pi s + \omega_1 t) \\ R_s \cos(4\pi s + \omega_1 t) \end{bmatrix}, \quad \mathbf{p}_{\text{tentilla}}(s, u, t) = \mathbf{r}_{\text{stem}}(s) + \begin{bmatrix} A_w \sin(\omega_2 t - k u) \\ u H \end{bmatrix}
formulaCompact: stem = [s*L + sin(1.2t + 4s)*25, sin(4πs + 0.8t)*R],  tentilla = [stem.x + sin(2.5t - 6u)*15u, stem.y + u*H]
